DSX.name: Dongsha Island (Pratas Island) Airport
DSX.reason: Dongsha is a restricted defense facility without public commercial passenger booking.

review_evidence.source_title: Taipei FIR AIP ENR 5.1 Restricted Areas
review_evidence.rationale: The official AIP describes Dongsha as continuously restricted and requiring prior authorization, so it is not a public commercial passenger airport.

HCN.name: Hengchun Airport
HCN.reason: Hengchun has no currently bookable scheduled commercial passenger service.

review_evidence.source_title: Taiwan CAA airport organization and current operations review
review_evidence.rationale: The airport remains operational under Kaohsiung management, but the current route review found no public scheduled passenger inventory; it must not be emitted as bookable.

HSZ.name: Hsinchu Air Base
HSZ.reason: Hsinchu Air Base is not a public commercial passenger airport.

review_evidence.source_title: Taiwan CAA airport distribution and operating-data review
review_evidence.rationale: The official civil-airport operating data does not list Hsinchu Air Base as a public passenger airport; the OurAirports row is military-only for catalog purposes.
